Lina (People Ops): Putting together a super short copy-paste manager onboarding snippet + a tiny day-7 close checklist. Want something managers can paste into Slack or Notion and use right away. Feedback?

Lina (People Ops): Snippet draft below — super terse.

---
Manager Onboarding Snippet (pasteable)

Hi {{name}}, welcome to Redwood! Im {{manager}}. Quick plan for the first week:
- Day 0: confirm Okta & MFA, accept device invite (IT)
- Day 1: 09:00 quick intro (10m), 09:15 setup check (20m), 10:00 product context + immediate small task (45m)
- Week: pair for first PR, join team sync, meet People Ops for benefits overview

Essentials for managers to do:
- Schedule 1:1 weekly and daily quick check-ins for week 1
- Assign onboarding buddy and add them to welcome message
- Raise access tickets within 24hrs if anything blocked (see access form)

Day-7 close checklist (manager)
- Confirm all access in Console is green
- First PR merged or doc contribution completed
- Set up 30/60/90 goals draft
- Book 30-day feedback touchpoint

Who-to-ask (short)
- IT (@Sam): device, Okta, VPN
- DevEx (@DevEx Bot / @Marta): repo & CI access
- Security (@sec-team): KMS, credentials requests
- HR (@Jordan): payroll, benefits window, probation cadence

Links and commands
- Access form: https://forms.redwood.com/onboard-request
- Create access ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa label: access-onboard
---

Avery (Eng Manager): This is great. Can we add a one-line note about oncall orientation if the role touches infra? Something like: "if relevant, 15m oncall orientation w/ owner".

Sam (IT): I'll wire up the Okta + laptop imaging flow so the "Day 0" step is mostly automatic. Will also add a one-click link to the access form.

Jordan (HR): Add the "benefits enrollment within 30 days" callout and mention probation check at 30/60. Also we schedule an intro with People Ops in week 1 (30m).

Lina (People Ops): Updated the snippet to mention People Ops intro. Also added day-7 close checklist. Can someone take ownership of the buddy roster?

Avery (Eng Manager): I can own the Eng buddy roster for the next quarter and post a short rota in #eng. :ok_hand:

onboard-bot: Reminder set: "Publish manager snippet to Notion" in 2 days.

DevEx Bot: Added repo access playbook link to the draft.

Lina (People Ops): Perfect. Once Notion is live I'll drop a tiny Slack welcome template managers can copy: "Hi team — please welcome {{name}}, {role}. Buddy: {{buddy}}. First week priorities: ..."

Sam (IT): FYI: access tickets created automatically when HR form has the #onboard flag. Posting link to form again: https://forms.redwood.com/onboard-request

Avery (Eng Manager): Thanks everyone 44aa

(End thread)
